ownership.config: Immutable base plus one override store; applied/exported metadata preserve legacy live/export semantics in that same store. Provider materialization is a read cache refreshed on writes; stable accessors contain no mutable facts or Proxy.
ownership.catalogs: Maps/fish/item catalogs keep their own mutable authoring owner; override resolution cannot mutate them. DEV catalog overlays only templates; Root receives that catalog explicitly.
ownership.debuff: Domain keeps the two existing debuff private facts; immutable view reads those facts without allocation. DEV formatter owns the live display; legacy getter/API retained pending Stage 7.

publicApi.domain: Fish.activeDebuffName remains unchanged as a compatibility projection; Fish.getDebuffState() adds a stable immutable view of the existing private facts without another state owner.
publicApi.application: getActiveDebuffName()/activeDebuffName remain unchanged; debug adapter adds getDebuffState()/debuffState for native DEV display.
publicApi.stage7: After reviewing any external API consumers, retire the legacy text projection and its Application forwarding; do not rename/remove either API in Stage 6.

saveCompatibility: Both DEV template IDs name build-template/instance IDs, not stored item definitions. Existing saves contain sys_build_box and ordinary rod/line/float/hook/reel definitions and retain the old instance/build IDs; removal of template seeding from fresh Production does not change serialized records or restoration.
